plugin.name: Backup Destinations
plugin.description: Unlocks remote backup destination UIs in CPN Panel: Google Drive (Disk), remote SFTP/SCP, FTP, S3-compatible object storage, Dropbox, and Incremental restic jobs. Create, Restore, Schedule, and local Destinations remain core. Free Host package.
plugin.keywords: backup, backups, google drive, gdrive, disk, sftp, scp, ftp, remote, s3, aws, dropbox, restic, incremental, destinations
plugin.author: master3395

features.feature: Enables CPN Backups → Google Drive (Disk) UI
Enables CPN Backups → Remote SFTP/SCP UI

plugin.uninstall_impact: Hides Google Drive, Remote SFTP/SCP, FTP, S3, Dropbox, and Incremental backup UIs until the plugin is installed again
Clears the host backup-destinations feature flag
Create, Restore, Schedule, and local Destinations stay available
Does not delete existing local backup archives or stored destination secrets
